spiritgiven.comments: There were several instances when body contact was not avoided but calls were resolved quickly.

We're thankful to the spirit captain for reminding the players to avoid contact. However, there were still several instances of body contact that were not avoided, even there was enough space to do so.
They were calm during discussions of the calls. All players including the sideline were positive and had good energy during the whole game.
Improved SOTG from previous game! Love all the smiles :)

We commend your improved SOTG compared to previous game. Thank you for the adjustment in avoiding contact. We'd like to applaud your spirit captain for calling the spirit timeout to clarify some calls.
Really love the spirit of this team!

spiritreceived.comments: There was a discussion about a pick being called (by our player) while being too far away—we felt that at the time the pick occurred, the players were close, but because the offensive player was looking at the disc/their teammate, they did not realize at the time the defensive player was close enough to be able to make a play if the pick hadn’t occurred. But, we completely understood your perspective as well, as players can get so far apart in a moment, and are glad we could discuss it with you.

Thank you for talking things out with us! We would also like to give some feedback about your sideline - sideline tends to get frustrated and make comments about the call on the field, letting the players talk it out and echoing the hand signs if a foul/call has occurred would be good. Take note about the pulls as well, if no hand was raised on our end, defence can only pull on the third whistle. Other than that, great game!
The situation of counting down, a player called 8,9 and 10 was too fast, and called for that.

Had a discussion during the game regarding fouls and body contact which we appreciated 
However we felt that after the discussion,  the contact got worse - Pushing with the body or actively running and swinging arms out to stop path of cuts

Fouls and body contact: even after the spirit time out, our players still felt the pushing of arms, pushing players out of the way to get into the lane. Even after individual discussions, there was no adjustment 

Communication: during discussion of calls, our players felt that there was a defensive tone when they were trying to explain their point of view and it seemed that there was an unwillingness for open discussion
Congratulations!! You guys are so tough!!thanks for good game!!
